high_level_description: This image is a tweet from the Twitter account @kobemurals, which is dedicated to sharing murals of Kobe Bryant and his daughter Gianna Bryant. The tweet announces a new mural featuring Kobe Bryant with the phrase "No time to lose" prominently displayed. Mural Content: The mural depicts a large-scale portrait of Kobe Bryant on two adjacent buildings. The text "NO TIME TO LOSE" is written in bold, black letters on a bright yellow background, which is part of the Nike logo and branding. The Nike swoosh is also visible below the text
